name: pi-carryover
description: Cross-session work carryover for pi: auto-loaded project state notes + /resume session linkage, with 3-tier reliability (agent-maintained notes, LLM exit summary, raw fallback). v1.1: topic-aware compaction with local embedding models (language-routed, enabled by default) — detects topic shifts and suggests/auto-compacts old context, archiving every compaction summary as a topic archive.
author: Feng-H
